description: This Java class 'DepositAccountInterestIncentiveData' represents data related to interest incentive configurations for deposit accounts within the Apache Fineract project. It provides static factory methods for creating instances from raw parameters or other data objects, and encapsulates various attributes such as entity type, attribute name, condition type, incentive type, and amount.
